paragraphs: Rav Dima bar Chinena said: this statement of Rava is subject to a dispute involving Rabbi Shimon. Rav Dimi and Rav Safra: Eruvin 61. He came with his brother Ravin before Rava: Bava Batra 13b. Rav Chisda said: it was a familiar saying in Rav Dimi bar Chinena’s mouth, Zevachim 36b. Rabbi Chiyya, son of Rabbah bar Nachmani, said to him (see his entry).
